name: Abubakar Vagaev
summary: Former WFCA and ACA welterweight champion from Chechnya (25-4), a 33-year-old Khamzat Chimaev training partner now moving up to middleweight for his second UFC fight. A grinding wrestler and five-round veteran (six five-round decision wins) who won his UFC debut over Saygid Izagakhmaev on takedowns and control, but tired and was hurt and nearly submitted in round three.

how_they_fight.Striking: Serviceable but hittable: about 3.3 significant strikes landed and 3.6 absorbed a minute at 43% accuracy. Izagakhmaev out-landed him 33-27 in our stats and hurt him with right hands. Works knees and body shots from the clinch; his knockout power shows up mainly in early regional finishes (last stoppage win in 2017).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Takedowns, trips and cage control are his scoring method: 4 of 10 takedowns and almost 8 minutes of control in the debut, repeatedly tripping Izagakhmaev back down off the fence. Rarely submits anyone (one career sub, 2014).
how_they_fight.Defense: Takedown defense about 68%. Durability is a question: stopped three times, all by strikes (Beslan Ushukov in round four in 2016, Murad Abdulaev in round two in 2018, Vitaliy Slipenko 20 seconds into round two in 2022), and he gave up mount and his back in round three of his UFC debut.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A decision fighter: 20 of 25 wins went the distance, including six five-round decisions in WFCA/ACA. His five finishes all came in rounds one or two. In the UFC debut he 'looked pretty tired' in round two per Cageside Press and lost round three (hurt, taken down, arm-triangle and armbar threats), so he banks early rounds and fades late. Stoppage losses came in R2 (twice) and R4.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced and controlled in title fights, but in the UFC debut he kept shooting from too close to the cage in round three and got reversed. He said he was not satisfied with that performance.

patterns: Front-loads his grappling: wins rounds one and two on takedowns and control
Decision winner: 20 of 25 wins by decision; no finish since 2017
Clinch knees and body work against the fence
Has faded late in three-round fights at UFC pace
concerns: First fight at middleweight; he said he weighed about 100 kg before his debut and has been told to watch his weight, so the cut and size change are unknowns
Stopped three times by strikes, all in rounds two or four
Age 33 with a long regional career
Caught a slight cold during camp (per Metaratings), said he has recovered
keys_to_beat: Survive and defend the early takedowns, then push the pace in round three
Land right hands in the exchanges; he has been hurt by them
Get up off the fence and punish tired re-shots
Take dominant positions in late scrambles

news.text: Made weight at the official weigh-ins: 185.5 lb (Malkoun 186). First cut to middleweight done without trouble.
Sherdog preview: -165 favourite (Malkoun +140); notes he tired in his July debut, says the move to 185 may help his cardio, and picks him by decision.
Says the middleweight bout with Malkoun was offered about six weeks before the event; he had told the UFC he would fight at 170 or 185.
Caught a slight cold during camp but says he is fine; planned to fly to the UAE early to acclimatise and start his weight cut after one last hard sparring week.
Won his UFC debut by unanimous decision (29-28 x3) over Saygid Izagakhmaev, a late replacement for Magomedrasul Gasanov.
Record note: a Telecomasia interview lists him at 26-4; our verified data and Metaratings have 25-4.
